proposal.quote: the President’s Proclamation of May 1, 1937
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The letter administers arms exports under the President's Proclamation of May 1, 1937, the proclamation issued under the Neutrality Act regime of 1 May 1937, indicating that regime is in force.

proposal.quote: the German-Japanese anti-comintern pact of November, 1936
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage names the German-Japanese anti-Comintern pact of November 1936, reporting the pact as in existence.

proposal.quote: Japan is locked in a bitter military struggle with Russia’s virtual ally, China
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage explicitly reports Japan as engaged in a bitter military struggle with China, meeting the threshold of general war in China.

proposal.quote: the recent visit of Mussolini to Berlin, on which occasion the heads of the two outstanding anti-Communist states assailed communism and reasserted their common determination to save Europe and the world from the menace of bolshevism
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports Mussolini’s Berlin visit and a joint German-Italian determination against bolshevism, an explicit statement of Rome-Berlin alignment.

proposal.quote: I remarked that in the last few weeks there had seemed to be a stiffening of the Franco-British attitude vis-à-vis Italy in the Spanish and Mediterranean questions. Rochat said that this was true and that it could not be otherwise.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports a hardening of Franco-British policy toward Italy over Spain and the Mediterranean, meeting the threshold for Italy being estranged from the West.

proposal.quote: England and France had taken the initiative of making this proposal to Italy and they could not in the event of a negative reply by their inaction seem to say to the Italians “all right go ahead and dig yourselves in in the Balearics, cut off our communications in the Mediterranean, we will do nothing about it.”
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports France and Britain confronting Italian hostile pressure (Balearics, Mediterranean communications) over Spain, i.e. Italy estranged from the West, meeting the estrangement threshold.

proposal.quote: It appeared that Italy was about to reject the French-British offer and, in view of information respecting the landing of Italian troops in Cadiz and Italian air reinforcements in Majorca, he thought the French Government would be constrained to speak firmly.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports Italy rejecting a French-British offer while landing troops and air reinforcements in Spain against Western interests, i.e. estranged from the West (threshold: estrangement after Ethiopia).
